brand.name: HomeLink Africa
brand.tagline: Amacumbi, imodoka n'ingendo byagenzuwe mu Rwanda hose.

landing.heroBody: Buri cumbi, imodoka n'umuyobozi kuri HomeLink byagenzuwe imbonankubone n'itsinda ryacu i Kigali. Niba biri hano, twarabigezeho.
landing.feedTitle: Byagenzuwe i Kigali muri iki cyumweru
landing.smartTitle: Baza nk’uko wabaza inshuti i Kigali
landing.smartBody: Andika interuro. Ishakisha rimenya agace, ingano, ingengo y’imari n’amatariki, rikakwereka uko ryabyumvise, kandi rigashakira gusa mu byo itsinda ryacu ryagenzuye.
landing.smartHint: Kanda ⌘K cyangwa / kuri paji iyo ari yo yose.
landing.placesBody: Twose twasuwe n’itsinda ryacu. Umubare ni amacumbi yagenzuwe ahari uyu munsi.
landing.howBody: Amasezerano atatu, buri rimwe ryubahirizwa n’umuntu kandi rigacungwa na porogaramu.

how.inspectBody: Buri cumbi rigenzurwa ku ngingo 34: umuvuduko w’amazi, umuriro w’inyongera, umuhanda, igikoni. Amafoto tuyifatira ubwacu.
how.escrowBody: Ubwishyu bufatwa kugeza wemeje ko wageze. Niba atari uko byavuzwe, usubizwa amafaranga yose ukabona n’indi nzu muri iryo joro.
how.peopleBody: Abakira abashyitsi, abagenzuzi n’abayobozi b’ingendo ushobora kwandikira mu mazina yabo.

landing.daysBody: Ingagi, ikiyaga, ishyamba n’umujyi, hamwe n’abayobozi tuzi ku giti cyabo.

steps.inspectedBody: Byasuzumwe hakurikijwe urutonde rw'ingingo 34: umuvuduko w'amazi, umuriro w'inyongera, inzira igera aho, n'igikoni.
steps.photographedBody: Buri foto iri hano yafashwe n'itsinda rya HomeLink. Nta foto yatanzwe na nyir'inzu igaragara ku cumbi ryagenzuwe.
steps.identityBody: Impapuro z'ubutaka cyangwa uburenganzira bwo gukodesha byagenzuwe hifashishijwe indangamuntu. Bikorwa mbere y'uko amafaranga yishyurwa.
steps.escrowBody: Amafaranga abikwa kugeza wemeje ko wageze. Nibitaba nk'uko byasobanuwe, usubizwa amafaranga yose kandi tugushakira ubundi bucumbi kuri uwo mugoroba.

car.inspectedBody: Yasukuwe, yageragezwe mu muhanda, kandi igenzurwa hakurikijwe urutonde rw'ingingo 22: amapine, feri, ipine ry'inyongera, ikoresho ryo kuzamura, n'impapuro.
car.identityBody: Ubwo nyir'imodoka n'ubwishingizi byagenzuwe hifashishijwe icyangombwa cy'imodoka mbere yo gukodeshwa.
car.photographedBody: Yafashwe amafoto n'itsinda rya HomeLink. Buri foto ni iy'iyi modoka nyirizina, si ifoto y'ubucuruzi y'ubwoko bwayo.
car.title: Yagenzuwe n'uwayitwaye

experience.inspectedBody: Yakozwe yose n'umukozi wacu mbere yo gushyirwaho, hakurikijwe igenzura ry'ingingo 18: umutekano, igihe, n'ibirimo koko.
experience.identityBody: Uruhushya rw'umuyobozi n'icyemezo cya pariki byagenzuwe, kandi bivugururwa buri gihembwe.
experience.photographedBody: Yafashwe amafoto ku rugendo nyarwo n'itsinda rya HomeLink.

sale.photographedBody: Amafoto yafashwe n’itsinda rya HomeLink: iyi nzu n’iki kibanza, si igishushanyo.
sale.identityBody: Icyangombwa cy’ubutaka cyagenzuwe mu bitabo by’ubutaka n’indangamuntu y’ugurisha mbere yo gushyirwa ku rubuga.

empty.noResultsBody: Dushyiraho gusa ibyo twagenzuye, bityo ibisubizo ni bike kurusha uko wabitekerezaga. Gerageza kwagura amatariki cyangwa gukuraho akayunguruzo.
empty.comingSoonBody: Uru rupapuro ruri mu miterere ariko ntirurimo ibintu.

detail.unavailable: Hitamo amatariki kugira ngo urebe igiteranyo
detail.leaseBody: Amezi cumi n'abiri cyangwa arenga bikorwa nk'ubusabe bw'amasezerano yo gukodesha aho kuba ugufata ku ijoro: impapuro, ingwate, n'amasezerano ashyizweho umukono.
detail.houseRulesBody: Kwinjira guhera saa munani, gusohoka mbere ya saa tanu. Nta birori. Gucecekera nyuma ya saa yine z'ijoro, abaturanyi bazabishimira.

lease.moveInBody: Iboneka guhera {date}. Ubukode bumara nibura amezi cumi n’abiri, uhereye ku kwezi uhitamo usaba.
lease.depositBody: {deposit}, abikwa nk’ingwate agasubizwa ubukode burangiye. Amabwiriza y’ingwate azana n’amasezerano.
lease.viewingBody: Itsinda ry’i Kigali rigutegurira gusura inzu rikakoherereza amasezerano ngo uyasome mbere. Nta mafaranga yishyurwa hano.

detail.managedBy: {name} ni we wita kuri iyi nzu · mu itsinda kuva {year}

quote.chargedIn: Bishyurwa muri {currency}. Bihinduwe ku giciro cy'uyu munsi; umubare wishyurwa wemezwa mbere yo kwishyura.
quote.noHiddenFees: Nta mafaranga yo gufata yongerwaho ku iherezo. Iki ni cyo giciro.

checkout.title: Emeza kandi wishyure
checkout.mobileNumberError: Nimero z'u Rwanda zigira imibare 9. Genzura nimero wongere ugerageze.
checkout.stubNotice: Iyi ni igerageza. Nta mafaranga azakurwaho.
checkout.escrowTitle: Amafaranga yawe aguma ashobora gusubizwa kugeza winjiye
checkout.escrowBody: Tubika amafaranga yose, kandi tuyafata nk'ayacu ari uko umuntu wo mu itsinda yemeje ko winjiye. Niba inzu idahuye n'ibyavuzwe, usubizwa amafaranga yose kandi tukagushakira indi nzu muri iryo joro.
checkout.noEscrowBody: Ubu bucumbi buri munsi y'urugero rwacu rwo kubika amafaranga, bityo ubwishyu bugera ako kanya. Ubwizerane ku byasobanuwe buracyariho.
checkout.cancellation: Guhagarika ku buntu kugeza {date}. Nyuma y'aho, ijoro rya mbere ntirisubizwa.
checkout.agree: Mu kwishyura wemera amabwiriza yo gufata n'amabwiriza yo guhagarika ari hejuru.

car.guaranteeBody: Yasukuwe, yageragejwe mu muhanda kandi igenzurwa ku wa {date} hakurikijwe urutonde rwacu rw'ingingo {points}: amapine, feri, ipine ry'inyongera, ikoresho ryo kuzamura n'impapuro. Niba imodoka idahuye n'ibivugwa ku rupapuro rwayo, ntuyishyura.

experience.guaranteeTitle: {name} wo mu itsinda ryacu yakoze uru rugendo
experience.guaranteeBody: Rwakozwe rwose kandi rugenzurwa ku wa {date} hakurikijwe urutonde rwacu rw'ingingo {points}: umutekano, igihe n'ibirimo koko. Niba urugendo rudahuye n'ibivugwa ku rupapuro rwarwo, ntururiha.
experience.cancellation: Iyo umunsi uhagaritswe kubera umutekano, usubizwa amafaranga yose.

checkout.emailError: Genzura imeyili. Igomba kugira @ n'izina rya domeni, nka izina@urugero.com.
checkout.phoneError: Andika nimero tugushakiraho, ushyiremo kode y'igihugu niba atari iy'u Rwanda.
checkout.cardNumberError: Nimero z'ikarita zigira imibare kuva kuri 13 kugeza kuri 19. Genzura nimero wongere ugerageze.
checkout.cardHolderError: Andika izina nk'uko ryanditse ku ikarita.
checkout.expiryError: Andika itariki irangiriraho mu buryo UK/UM, kandi urebe ko ikarita itarata agaciro.
checkout.cvcError: Kode y'umutekano ni imibare 3 cyangwa 4 yanditse ku ikarita.

confirmation.title: Wafashe neza
confirmation.body: Twoherereje amakuru kuri imeyili yawe kandi dufungura ikiganiro n'itsinda rifasha.
confirmation.next1: Aline wo mu itsinda ryacu i Kigali azakwandikira mu masaha make kugira ngo yemeze uko uzagera.
confirmation.next2: Amafaranga yawe aguma abitswe kugeza wemeje ko wageze.
confirmation.next3: Nka icyumweru mbere yuko ugera, Aline azakubaza niba ushaka imodoka cyangwa ikindi kintu.
confirmation.arrangeBody: Imodoka ku kibuga cy'indege, umushoferi w'icyumweru, cyangwa urugendo rukwiye. Bibwire itsinda ry'i Kigali maze babigutegurire — nta kundi gufata, nta konti yindi.
confirmation.arrangeNote: Bazongera bakubaze nka icyumweru mbere yuko ugera, numara kumenya indege yawe.
confirmation.cancelledNote: Ubu bwiyandikishe bwarahagaritswe. Nta kindi ugomba, kandi ayo wari wamaze kwishyura yasubijwe hakoreshejwe uburyo wishyuriye.
confirmation.recordNote: Byabikiwe ku wa {date}. Icyo ushaka guhindura cyose kinyura mu itsinda ryo i Kigali, atari mu ifishi.

cars.title: Imodoka
cars.subtitle: {count, plural, one {imodoka # yagenzuwe} other {imodoka # zagenzuwe}} i Kigali, zisukurwa kandi zigenzurwa mbere ya buri gukodesha.
cars.paperworkSelfBody: Zana uruhushya rwawe rwo gutwara, n'urwa mpuzamahanga niba uturutse hanze. Ubwishingizi, ikarita y'imodoka n'ikimenyetso cy'impanuka biri mu gasanduku.
cars.paperworkDriverBody: Nta cyo uzana. Umushoferi ni we ufite uruhushya, ubwishingizi n'impapuro zo kwinjira muri pariki.
cars.fuelBody: Uyakira yuzuye, uyisubiza yuzuye. Nta rugero rw'ibirometero, kandi nta kiguzi cyo gusohoka i Kigali.
cars.cancellationBody: Guhagarika ku buntu kugeza ku wa {date}. Nyuma yaho umunsi wa mbere ntusubizwa.

experiences.title: Ingendo
experiences.subtitle: {count, plural, one {urugendo #} other {ingendo #}} hamwe n'abayobozi tuzi amazina yabo.
experiences.guideRole: Umuyobozi wemewe. Si umukozi wa HomeLink.
experiences.bringBody: Inkweto zifunze, ikoti ry'imvura, n'amazi. Ibindi bikoresho byihariye biraboneka kandi biri mu giciro.
experiences.weatherBody: Hano imvura igwa nyuma ya saa sita kandi gake ihagarika ikintu. Iyo umunsi uhagaritswe kubera umutekano, amafaranga asubizwa yose.
experiences.ageBody: Kuva ku myaka {age} kuzamura. Iyo mipaka ishyirwaho na pariki cyangwa uwatanze urugendo, si twe, kandi igenzurwa aho muhurira.

searchPanel.leaseNote: Umwaka cyangwa urenga ni amasezerano yo gukodesha, si ugufata ku ijoro. Tuzagufasha ku mpapuro n'ingwate.

highlight.inspectedBody: {name} yagenzuye aha hantu imbonankubone ku wa {date}, atari ku rupapuro.
highlight.escrowBody: Turayabika, tukayafata nk'ayacu ari uko itsinda ryemeje ko winjiye.
highlight.powerBody: Jenerateri iri aho, yakoreshejwe kandi yuzuyemo lisansi mu igenzura.
highlight.fibreBody: Umuvuduko wageragezwe uwo munsi, ntabwo wavuye mu kwamamaza.
highlight.photosBody: Yafashwe n'itsinda ryacu. Nta na kimwe cyavuye kuri telefone ya nyir'inzu.

carHighlight.inspectedBody: {name} yayisuzumye kandi arayitwara ku wa {date}, akurikije urutonde rw'ingingo {points}.
carHighlight.driverBody: Igiciro kirimo umuntu umaze imyaka atwara kuri izi nzira. Ku mihanda ya pariki, si ubusabusa.
carHighlight.automaticBody: Kigali yubatswe ku misozi kandi imodoka zihagarara hagati mu kuzamuka. Iyi ihindura vitesi ku bwawe.
carHighlight.unpavedBody: Iri hejuru kandi ikoresha impande enye, kuko kimwe cya kabiri cy'ahantu heza hareka kuba imihanda.
carHighlight.groupBody: Intebe {count}, nta wukurikira mu yindi modoka kandi nta wutandukana n'abandi.
carHighlight.fleet: Hafi buri gihe haba hari iboneka
carHighlight.fleetBody: {count} zihari ubu, bityo guhindura amatariki gake bigutwara ubwo bwiyandikishe.

experienceHighlight.inspected: Umwe muri twe yakoze uwo munsi wose
experienceHighlight.inspectedBody: {name} yagiye muri uru rugendo nyirizina ku wa {date}, kuva ku ntangiriro kugeza ku iherezo, mbere y'uko rushyirwa ku rubuga.
experienceHighlight.permitBody: Impushya z'i Birunga zishira amezi menshi mbere kandi zishyurwa mu madolari. Urwawe rurabikwa, kandi ruri mu giciro.
experienceHighlight.halfDayBody: Amasaha {count} uvuye mu rugo ukanagaruka, bityo bikwira mbere cyangwa nyuma y'akazi.
experienceHighlight.smallGroupBody: Ntirirenga {count}. Ntukurikira ibendera ryazamuwe mu bantu benshi.
experienceHighlight.foodBody: Ritekerwa aho uri n'abahatuye, ntiriva mu gikoni cyo i Kigali.
experienceHighlight.fullDayBody: Amasaha {count} hamwe n'urugendo ruva i Kigali rukanagaruka, atari isaha ugomba kubakira umunsi wose.

trips.title: Ingendo zawe
trips.subtitle: Ibyo wabitse byose hamwe natwe, n'ikiganiro kijyana na buri kimwe.
trips.emptyBody: Nta cyo warabika. Ibiri kuri HomeLink byose byagenzuwe imbonankubone, bityo ni bike kuruta uko wabitekerezaga — kandi nta gitangaza uzasanga ugezeyo.
trips.notYoursBody: Ingendo ni aho ibyo wowe wabitse biba. Niba utanga ikintu kuri HomeLink biri muri Ibyo ntanga, kandi niba uri mu itsinda ryo i Kigali biri mu Murongo.

subtitle.stay: Ibyo washyize kuri urubuga, ibyabitswe, n'igihe amafaranga akugeraho.
subtitle.car: Imodoka ufite, izakodeshejwe, n'igihe amafaranga akugeraho.
subtitle.experience: Ibyo uyobora hamwe natwe, ibyabitswe, n'igihe amafaranga akugeraho.

inventory.nothingBooked: Nta cyo kirabikwa. Ibyabitswe bigaragara hano ako kanya umukiriya yishyuye.
inventory.payoutAfterCheckIn: Wishyurwa umukiriya amaze kwemeza ko yageze
inventory.moneyNote: Nta kintu kuri iyi paji cyimura amafaranga. Kwishyura bikorwa n'itsinda ryo i Kigali, kandi izi ngano ni zo bakoresha.
inventory.notYoursBody: Iyi paji ni iy'abashoferi n'abayobozi b'ingendo. Niba uri umushyitsi, ibyo wafashe biri muri Ingendo.
inventory.ownershipNote: Ibyo HomeLink yagenzuye byose muri iki cyiciro. Uwo ari we utunze iki nticyarashyirwaho — muri V1 ibyatanzwe bishyirwaho n'itsinda rya konsiyeji, bityo nk'aho hari umutanzi umwe.
inventory.rateYours: Umushyitsi yishyura iki giciro hiyongereyeho amafaranga ya serivisi
inventory.breakdownNote: Amafaranga ya serivisi yongerwa ku giciro cyawe igihe umushyitsi yishyura, ntakurwa ku giciro cyawe.

messaging.title: Ubutumwa
messaging.noThreads: Nta kiganiro kiraboneka. Gifungurwa ako kanya ubwiyandikishe bwemejwe.
messaging.attachLimits: JPEG, PNG cyangwa WebP, kugeza kuri 15MB. Aho ifoto yafatiwe hakurwaho mbere yo kubikwa.

subtitleFor.guest: Buri kiganiro gifitanye isano n’icyo wabitse, n’itsinda rya Kigali cyangwa n’ugusanganira.
subtitleFor.supply: Ibiganiro ku bwiyandikishe bw’ibyo utanga. Itsinda rifasha riri muri buri kimwe.
subtitleFor.ops: Ibiganiro byose itsinda rifasha ririmo, buri kimwe gifitanye isano n’ubwiyandikishe cyangwa urugendo.

messaging.sendOff: Kohereza ntibirakora kugeza ubutumwa butangiye gukora

queue.subtitle: Ibitegereje kugenzurwa, ibyo umukiriya yasabye umuntu, ibigomba abatanga serivisi, n'abategereje igisubizo.
queue.notYours: Iyi paji ni iy'itsinda ryo i Kigali
queue.notYoursBody: Umurongo ni igikoresho cy'itsinda rya konsiyeji. Niba warabitse, biri muri Ingendo; niba utanga ikintu, biri muri Ibyo ntanga.
queue.emptyOpen: Nta kiri gutegereza. Byose muri iki gice byarangiye.

note.verify: Nta kintu kijya ku rubuga hatabanje kuhagera umuntu. Ibitaraboneka itariki y'uruzinduko biri hejuru.
note.asks: Buri buto « andikira itsinda » buri ku cyemezo bugera hano nk'akazi k'umuntu. Urutonde rurerure ni impamvu yo gushyira kimwe muri ibi mu buryo bwo kwiyandikisha.
note.payouts: Ayo mafaranga abitswe umukiriya abona nk'umutekano, arebwa n'inyuma nk'akazi. Ayabitswe ategereza ko kugera kwemezwa.
note.threads: Ibiganiro byose itsinda ririmo. Akadomo kuzuye ni umuntu udutegereje.

places.Gacuriro: Inzu ziri mu ngo zirinzwe ku musozi wo mu majyaruguru, zikunzwe n’imiryango.
places.Gikondo: Imihanda ituje, ifite imbuga nyazo, hafi y’umujyi.
places.Kacyiru: Ambasade na minisiteri, inzira nini z’abanyamaguru, n’amagoroba atuje.
places.Kibagabaga: Agace gatuwe kandi gafite ibiti, hafi y’isoko rya Kimironko.
places.Kicukiro: Iminota cumi n’itanu uvuye ku kibuga cy’indege, kandi igiciro kiringaniye.
places.Kimihurura: Amaresitora yo kuri KG 5, Convention Centre, n’imisozi ireba kure.
places.Kiyovu: Umujyi wa kera: rwagati, ugenderwamo n’amaguru, kandi utuje nijoro.
places.Nyamirambo: Umuhanda ufite ubuzima kurusha indi i Kigali: ikawa, umuziki n’amabara.
places.Nyarutarama: Inzu nini hafi y’ikibuga cya golf n’umuhanda w’ikiyaga.
places.Rebero: Umusozi muremure wo mu majyepfo, umujyi wose uri munsi yawo.
places.Remera: Hafi ya sitade na BK Arena, ku mirongo yose ya bisi.

trips.title: Ingendo zawe
trips.body: Injira urebe aho uzacumbika, imodoka n’ibikorwa by’umunsi, buri kimwe n’inomero yacyo, amatariki n’uwo wandikira.

messages.title: Ubutumwa
messages.body: Injira usome ibiganiro bijyana na buri gufata, n'itsinda rya Kigali, umushoferi wawe cyangwa umuyobozi w'urugendo.

abroad.title: Kugura uri mu mahanga
abroad.intro: Benshi mu bagura inzu kuri twe baba hanze y'u Rwanda. Uku ni ko kugura bigenda iyo udashobora kuba i Kigali kuri buri ntambwe.
abroad.viewBody: Umugenzuzi wazengurutse inzu agukorera isura kuri videwo, imbonankubone, agasubiza ibibazo byawe mu byumba.
abroad.papersBody: Icyangombwa cy'ubutaka, imbibi z'ikibanza n'indangamuntu y'ugurisha uzibona mbere y'uko utanga igiciro.
abroad.poaBody: Ububasha bwemejwe na noteri butuma umuvandimwe cyangwa umunyamategeko i Kigali agusinyira.
abroad.moneyBody: Amafaranga anyura kuri banki ajya kuri konti ya noteri, ntanyura mu ntoki kandi ntanyura kuri HomeLink.
abroad.notaryBody: Noteri wigenga yandikisha ihererekanya mu biro by'ubutaka, ugahabwa icyangombwa gishya.

prefs.title: Igenamiterere ry'imenyesha
prefs.intro: Hitamo uko buri bwoko bw'amakuru bukugeraho. Porogaramu ihora ibika kopi mu menyesha ryawe.
prefs.locked: Buri gihe birakora: iri risaba ko ugira icyo ukora.
prefs.quietBody: Nta SMS, WhatsApp cyangwa imenyesha rya telefoni hagati y'aya masaha. Ibibazo byihutirwa by'ubwishyu biraza uko byagenda kose.
prefs.pushBody: Menyeshwa igihe hari ikigukeneye, n'iyo HomeLink ifunze.
prefs.pushGranted: Birakora. Iyi mushakisha izerekana imenyesha rya HomeLink.
prefs.pushDenied: Byahagaritswe muri iyi mushakisha. Kugira ngo uhindure, fungura igenamiterere ry'urubuga uhereye ku gafunguzo kari mu mwanya wa aderesi.
prefs.pushUnsupported: Iyi mushakisha ntishobora kwerekana imenyesha. Imeyili, SMS na WhatsApp biracyakora.

airportPickup.body: Umushoferi akwakira aho abagenzi basohokera afite izina ryawe, igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.

fullInsurance.name: Ubwishingizi bwuzuye
fullInsurance.body: Nta mafaranga wishyura imodoka nibaramuka yangiritse. Ku munsi.

hold.gone: Undi muntu yafashe aya matariki muri icyo gihe.

details.signInBody: Amakuru yawe yiyuzuza, kandi ibyo ufashe bijya mu ngendo zawe.
details.orGuest: Cyangwa ukomeze nta konti. Ushobora gufungura konti numara gufata.
details.phoneHint: Tukoherereza amakuru yo kwinjira kuri SMS. Shyiramo kode y'igihugu niba nimero atari iy'u Rwanda.

details.arrivalHint: Kugira ngo hazabe umuntu ufite imfunguzo. Kwinjira ni guhera saa 14:00.
details.requestsPlaceholder: Igitanda cy'umwana, icyumba cyo hasi, indege igera bitinze…

extras.body: Buri kimwe gitegurwa n'itsinda ry'i Kigali. Ushobora no kubyongeraho nyuma uhereye ku byo wafashe.
extras.none: Nta cyo kongera kuri ibi wafashe.

review.cancelHalf: Usubizwa kimwe cya kabiri cy'amajoro, isuku n'ibyongerwaho byose
review.cancelPermit: Impushya za pariki zigurwa mu izina ryawe kandi ntizisubizwa na rimwe.

pay.title: Ishyura mu mutekano
pay.momoUnknown: Nimero za MTN zitangirwa na 078 cyangwa 079, iza Airtel na 072 cyangwa 073.
pay.secure: Birinzwe kuva ku ntangiriro kugeza ku iherezo. HomeLink ntibona nimero y'ikarita yawe yose.
pay.testHint: Igerageza: nta mafaranga akurwaho. Ikarita 4242 4242 4242 4242 iremerwa, 4000 0000 0000 0002 iranzwe, 4000 0027 6000 3184 isaba banki yawe kwemeza. Nimero ya Mobile Money irangira na 0000 itinda igahagarara, irangira na 1111 iranzwe.
pay.declinedBody: Nta mafaranga yakuweho. Genzura amakuru y'ikarita, gerageza indi karita, cyangwa wishyure na Mobile Money.
pay.agree: Mu kwishyura wemera amabwiriza y'inzu n'amabwiriza yo guhagarika ari hejuru.

threeDs.title: Emeza na banki yawe
threeDs.body: Banki yawe yohereje kode y'imibare 6 kuri telefoni ihujwe n'iyi karita.

driver.title: Uko uzagenda
driver.withDriverBody: Umushoferi wa HomeLink uzi imihanda. Lisansi na parikingi ni ibyacu.
driver.selfDriveBody: Uratwara ubwawe. Twongera kugenzura uruhushya rwawe tukaguha imodoka.
driver.licenceHint: Ifoto cyangwa PDF, itarenze MB 10. Uruhushya mpuzamahanga n'urw'u Rwanda byombi biremewe.
driver.licenceError: Ongeraho uruhushya rwawe kugira ngo utware ubwawe.
driver.flightHint: Turayikurikirana kandi tugutegereza niba utinze kugwa.
driver.flightError: Iyi ntisa n'inimero y'indege. Urugero: WB464.

people.title: Abazaza
people.body: Amazina nk'uko ari ku pasiporo cyangwa ku ndangamuntu. Umuyobozi abigenzura mu ntangiriro.
people.name: Amazina yose
people.ageError: Agomba kuba afite nibura imyaka {min} kuri uwo munsi.
people.passportError: Andika nimero ya pasiporo cyangwa y'indangamuntu.
people.permitNote: Pariki itanga uruhushya mu izina rya buri muntu, ni yo mpamvu dukeneye amakuru ya pasiporo. Uruhushya ntirushobora guhabwa undi cyangwa gusubizwa.
people.pickupHint: Tuzahurira hano. Ukeneye ko tugufata i Kigali? Bivuge mu ntambwe ikurikira.

application.body: Itsinda rya Kigali risoma buri cyifuzo. Ibi ni byo rikeneye kugira ngo rikwemerere vuba.

application.employerHint: Aho ukorera cyangwa wigira i Kigali, cyangwa ikigo cyakohereje hano.
application.incomeHint: Urugero rurahagije. Biguma hagati yawe n'itsinda rya Kigali.

incomeBands.500kTo1m: Kuva kuri RWF 500,000 kugeza kuri miliyoni 1
incomeBands.1mTo2m: Kuva kuri miliyoni 1 kugeza kuri 2 RWF

application.idHint: Ifoto y'urupapuro ruriho ifoto yawe. Si ngombwa ubu; irakenerwa mbere yo kwinjira.

agreement.title: Amasezerano y'ubukode
agreement.body: Soma kugeza ku iherezo. Ni yo masezerano uzabikaho kopi.
agreement.heading: Amasezerano y'ubukode bwa {home}
agreement.parties: Hagati ya HomeLink Africa Ltd, icunga inzu mu izina rya nyirayo, na {tenant}, ukodesha.
agreement.clauseHome: Inzu: {home}, {area}. Irimo ibikoresho nk'uko HomeLink yayigenzuye kandi ikayifotora.

agreement.clauseIncludes: Bibarirwa mu bukode: {includes}. Amashanyarazi akoresha mubazi y'ifatabuguzi iri mu izina ry'ukodesha.
agreement.clauseCare: Ukodesha agira isuku mu nzu kandi akamenyesha HomeLink ikintu cyose cyangiritse mu masaha 48; HomeLink ikora ku mafaranga yayo ibyangiritse bitatewe n'ukodesha.
agreement.clauseRules: Amabwiriza y'inzu wemeye mu igenzura ni kimwe mu bigize aya masezerano.
agreement.clauseLaw: Aya masezerano agengwa n'amategeko y'u Rwanda.
agreement.scrollHint: Manuka kugeza ku iherezo kugira ngo usinye.
agreement.sign: Andika amazina yawe yose kugira ngo usinye
agreement.signHint: Agomba guhura n'izina riri mu makuru yawe: {name}.

bank.referenceValue: Indango y'ibyo wafashe, igaragara ku rupapuro rukurikira
bank.placeholder: Amakuru ya konti y'igerageza; si konti nyakuri.

viewing.title: Saba gusura
viewing.intro: Umuntu wo mu itsinda rya Kigali azakuzengurutsa kandi asubize ibibazo ku cyangombwa cy'ubutaka, agace n'igiciro. Nta kwishyura.
viewing.videoBody: Kuzenguruka imbonankubone aho uri hose. Tukoherereza link umunsi ubanziriza.
viewing.notesPlaceholder: Ibibazo ku cyangombwa, gusura ubwa kabiri hamwe n'umupimisha…
viewing.doneBody: {date} saa {time}. Itsinda rya Kigali riremeza mu butumwa mu masaha make.
viewing.bringPerson: Uzane indangamuntu; umuzamu ku irembo azayigusaba.
